name: htqllh-school-management
description: Hệ thống Quản lý Lớp học & Học vụ (HTQLLH) — Root workspace

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "FRONTEND,BACKEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix members/member2_Frontend" "npm run dev --prefix members/member3_Backend_DB/school-management-nodejs"
scripts.start: concurrently --names "FRONTEND,BACKEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" "npm run build --prefix members/member2_Frontend && npm run preview --prefix members/member2_Frontend" "npm run start --prefix members/member3_Backend_DB/school-management-nodejs"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix members/member2_Frontend && npm install --prefix members/member3_Backend_DB/school-management-nodejs && npm install --prefix members/member4_Logic_Security
scripts.test: npm test --prefix members/member3_Backend_DB/school-management-nodejs && npm run test:unit --prefix members/member4_Logic_Security && node -e "import('./members/member5_Modules_QA/tests/unitTestingSuite.test.js').then(m => m.runSystemUnitTests())"
